english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something requiring little skill or effort.

examples.jyutping: ni1 tai4 sou3 hok6 hou2 jung4 ji6

english.note: Use this when “given to” means liable or prone to do something, rather than simply fond of it.

examples.english: They are given to saying the wrong thing whenever they drink.
examples.traditional: 佢一飲酒就容易講錯嘢。
